text:
Sam: heads up - prod embed service started showing sporadic heap spikes leading to OOM logs on a small set of requests. Pushed a hotfix image that caps in-memory shard size: redwood/embed:heap-balance-2026-03-22-ff12. Need to move quickly, propose a 15m fast window with tight metrics and an approval to bypass full canary.

DeployBot: [deploy-request] image=redwood/embed:heap-balance-2026-03-22-ff12 by Sam
Needs: ops-approval, service-owner, smoke-run
Link: https://deploy/redwood/embed/requests/7012349999

Aisha: how often are these OOMs happening? user visible?

Sam: ~0.6% of encode calls hit the path under high concurrency; some 5xxs seen on tails. No data corruption.

Oncall: I can take rollback ownership. My criteria: any OOMs >0.25% in the window or p95 latency regresses >150ms sustained.

Jordan: as service owner I need to verify image hash and unit tests. Provide sha and CI link.

Sam: image sha=ff12, CI green: https://ci/redwood/embed/ff12/artifacts. Patch limits per-shard heap to 200MB and toggles feature flag embed.heap_capping=true.

Mina: what smoke commands do we run? also prefer EU region separate validation before global swap.

Sam: smoke steps pasted below:
```
# smoke encode
curl -sS -X POST https://embed.prod/api/v1/encode -d '{"text":"smoke test","model":"embed-v2"}' | jq '.status'
# check OOM in logs for the last 10m
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=embed --since=10m | grep -i oom || true
# toggle check (feature flag ensures no global impact)
kubectl -n prod exec deploy/embed -- /bin/sh -c "env | grep HEAP"
```

DeployBot: Canary bypass requested. Policy: needs 2 human approvals. Current: 0/2.

Oncall: +1. I'll monitor and be ready to flip traffic back and run rollback job.

Jordan: I've reviewed the sha and unit tests. +1 from me if Oncall owns rollback and EU is held for separate validation.

Aisha: +1 provisional. Please ensure release note and runbook posted. Schedule the fast window at 02:10 UTC (10m ramp with 5m validation at 5% then ramp to 20% for 5m).

Sam: release note draft: "embed: cap per-shard heap to avoid tail OOMs during high concurrency. Backported to 1.2.x. Image heap-balance-2026-03-22-ff12." Runbook: watch embed.heap_oom_count, encode_error_rate, p95_latency; rollback to redwood/embed:1.2.8 if triggered.

DeployBot: Approvals recorded: Oncall, Jordan. Canary bypass granted. Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-23T02:10:00Z -> 02:25:00Z. Exec: https://deploy/redwood/embed/7012349999/exec

Sam: initiating window now. Mina please run smoke and pin EU off for now.

Mina: smoke executed - encode returned status OK. Logs show no OOMs in last 10m. EU region held.

Oncall: ramping to 5% now. Watching metrics: embed.heap_oom_count=0, error_delta +0.01%.

Aisha: 5m check - p95 stable, error_rate +0.03%. No OOM flags. Proceeding to 20%.

Oncall: 20% now. 5m timer started.

Sam: monitoring memory histograms. p99 memory down by ~30MB for hot path. Good signal.

Mina: 5m check at 20%: heap_oom_count=0, p95 +6ms, error delta +0.05%. All green.

Jordan: thanks team. I'll merge release note and tag the image in the release board. Hold EU until separate window tomorrow morning.

DeployBot: Deploy completed. Status: SUCCESS. Request closed by Sam.

Sam: closing - appreciate fast approvals. If any regressions, Oncall will pin back to 1.2.8 and we will open a rollback job. :white_check_mark:
